description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) models in terms of MRR@10 (Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10) as a function of the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled MRR@10, is scaled linearly from 33.0 to 36.5, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)", is also linear and spans from 1 to 10, with tick marks at each integer value. The plot compares six different models, each represented by a distinct line and marker: "DPR w/o query" (black solid line with square markers), "DPR w/ gold" (yellow solid line with diamond markers), "DPR w/ top-1" (green solid line with circle markers), "DPR w/ bottom-1" (purple dashed line with circle markers), "DPR w/ random" (blue dashed line with circle markers), and "DPR w/ curriculum" (red dashed line with circle markers). The "DPR w/ curriculum" model starts at an MRR@10 of approximately 35.5 and remains relatively stable, with a slight increase to about 35.6. The "DPR w/ top-1" model shows a significant increase, starting at 33.0 and rising to approximately 36.5. The "DPR w/ gold" model starts at 33.0 and increases to about 35.5. The "DPR w/ random" model starts at approximately 35.0 and remains stable. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" model starts at approximately 35.0 and remains stable. The "DPR w/o query" model starts at 33.0 and increases to about 35.5.
